title: Python: Sequence exhaustion handling
notes:
Already implemented. Python sequence exhaustion handling is complete:

1. OSCORE (crypto/oscore.py): Raises OverflowError at 40-bit limit. Constants: MAX_OSCORE_SEQUENCE_NUMBER, OSCORE_SEQUENCE_EXHAUSTED.

2. Link-layer TX (link/link_layer.py): Raises OverflowError when 24-bit tuple (255, 65535) exhausted.

3. Link-layer RX replay (link/replay.py): Issues warning at WRAPAROUND_WARNING_THRESHOLD. Rejects epoch rollover from 255 to 0.

4. OSCORE Context Store: Has GenerationOverflowError at u32 generation max, SequenceReservationError for sender sequence exhaustion.

All exhaustion tests pass. Mirrors Rust SeqExhausted using Python OverflowError.
